channel.title: Pier & Point · 1450 Owens Street
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 1450 Owens Street (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 1450 Owens Street: 1450 Owens no longer says the building came online in 2024. Bisnow (March 2026) says it is expected to come online in 2027, a city permit for the building's shell was closed on May 19, 2025, and the 2024 claim's source could not be read.
item.description: 1450 Owens no longer says the building came online in 2024. Bisnow (March 2026) says it is expected to come online in 2027, a city permit for the building's shell was closed on May 19, 2025, and the 2024 claim's source could not be read. Source: Bisnow, 2026-03-25 (bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/life-sciences/gladstone-institutes-leases-105k-sf-mission-bay-133827); DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permit 202012281760.

item.title: Correction · 1450 Owens Street: 1450 Owens Street's summary dated Gladstone Institutes' lease to 2024. Gladstone announced it in March 2026, with labs opening in early 2027; the summary now says so.
item.description: 1450 Owens Street's summary dated Gladstone Institutes' lease to 2024. Gladstone announced it in March 2026, with labs opening in early 2027; the summary now says so. Source: https://gladstone.org/news/gladstone-expands-research-footprint-105000-square-feet-new-laboratory-space.

item.title: Correction · 1450 Owens Street: The record said Gladstone signed its 105,000+ sq ft lease in 2024 and that the building came online in 2024. Gladstone's release and Bisnow are both dated 2026-03-25 and describe a lease announced then, with Gladstone's labs opening in early 2027; no source dates the lease to 2024. The record now shows DBI's shell-and-core permit complete on 2025-05-19 and says sources disagree on when the building came online. The August 2021 milestone no longer claims construction started (SF YIMBY dates the permits, not the start of work). The Bisnow article's title and date (2026-03-25) and the Gladstone release's title and date were corrected, the Wikimedia aerial's credit now names only the Commons username Firstcultural, and the map's land use is now commercial (the Assessor classes the building as Commercial Office).

item.title: Added · 1450 Owens Street: 1450 Owens Street added as a real Assessor-parcel record: a 7-story, ~1-acre Alexandria Center for Science and Technology lab/office building (DBI shows its shell-and-core construction permit 202012281760 complete on 2025-05-19; sources differ on when it came online). Gladstone Institutes (whose own separate 1650 Owens St headquarters is already tracked) announced in March 2026 that it had secured 105,000+ sq ft of laboratory space here (per Gladstone's own release and Bisnow, both dated 2026-03-25); this record tracks the real Alexandria-owned building, not a separate Gladstone-owned site. DataSF's Building Footprints layer only captures small roof fragments of this ~4,607 sq m parcel, so the map uses the Assessor parcel boundary directly.
item.description: 1450 Owens Street added as a real Assessor-parcel record: a 7-story, ~1-acre Alexandria Center for Science and Technology lab/office building (DBI shows its shell-and-core construction permit 202012281760 complete on 2025-05-19; sources differ on when it came online). Gladstone Institutes (whose own separate 1650 Owens St headquarters is already tracked) announced in March 2026 that it had secured 105,000+ sq ft of laboratory space here (per Gladstone's own release and Bisnow, both dated 2026-03-25); this record tracks the real Alexandria-owned building, not a separate Gladstone-owned site. DataSF's Building Footprints layer only captures small roof fragments of this ~4,607 sq m parcel, so the map uses the Assessor parcel boundary directly. Source: https://gladstone.org/news/gladstone-expands-research-footprint-105000-square-feet-new-laboratory-space.

item.title: Milestone · 1450 Owens Street: Gladstone Institutes announced it had secured 105,000+ sq ft of laboratory space in the building (about 20 labs for its data science and genomic immunology institutes), with move-in expected in early 2027; Alexandria's executive chairman called Gladstone the anchor tenant. (Mar 25, 2026)
